meta.source: Fresh identity for the CV Builder product (codebase fawadeqbal/cu-builder, phases 1–4).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and bars; the dotted preview canvas sits on it too.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, bars, dialogs, inputs. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Quiet fill on surface: table heads, hovered rows, wells, the form area behind panels.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Sunken tracks: segmented control and progress tracks, skeletons, switch off-state.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and drawers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative separation only (not a control boundary).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dividers that must read at a glance: table row rules in dense views, the split-pane handle.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, radios and secondary buttons: 3:1 on surface and canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body on surface, surface-2, canvas.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary body, field labels, table cells on surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Hints, meta lines, captions, placeholder text on surface, surface-2 and canvas (4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and values only; exempt from contrast, never for live content.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: EU blue. The one primary action per view, current navigation item marker, selected controls, progress fills.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, current nav item ground, brand badges, AI suggestion panels.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text: links and brand badges only. Headings, labels and current navigation stay in ink.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with a 2px surface gap; 3:1 on surface, canvas and brand-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gold. Highlights that celebrate: ratings, Premium tier, 'New', the folded corner of the mark. Fill only, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for highlight badges, keyword matches and Premium callouts.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Text on gold-soft and surface when a highlight needs words.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gold fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, saved, passed checks, offer stage. Always with a check icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention soon: deadlines, low credits, low-confidence fields. Text on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, failed checks. Text on surface and danger-soft; fill for the danger button.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error alerts, invalid field messages and danger badges.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral news: tips, plan notices, 'Applied' stage.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for info badges, tips and alerts.

tokens.name: stage-saved
tokens.usage: Tracker stage Saved: column dot, chart series.

tokens.name: stage-applied
tokens.usage: Tracker stage Applied.

tokens.name: stage-interview
tokens.usage: Tracker stage Interview.

tokens.name: stage-offer
tokens.usage: Tracker stage Offer.

tokens.name: stage-rejected
tokens.usage: Tracker stage Rejected; muted so a long column of rejections doesn't alarm.

tokens.name: tier-basic-bg
tokens.usage: Basic tier badge ground; text ink-2.

tokens.name: tier-standard-bg
tokens.usage: Standard tier badge ground; text info.

tokens.name: tier-premium-bg
tokens.usage: Premium tier badge ground; text gold-ink, spark icon.

tokens.name: tier-executive-bg
tokens.usage: Executive tier badge ground; text tier-executive-ink, spark icon.

tokens.name: tier-executive-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tier-executive-bg.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The CV sheet. Always white in both themes because it is what prints; text on it comes from the CV templates, never from ink.

tokens.name: appbar-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the global app bar: the blue band at the top of every page in light; surface in dark.

tokens.name: appbar-ink
tokens.usage: Logo, current link and icons on the app bar.

tokens.name: appbar-ink-2
tokens.usage: Other links on the app bar.

tokens.name: appbar-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground for links and controls on the app bar.

tokens.name: appbar-accent
tokens.usage: Underline under the current app-bar link.

tokens.name: appbar-line
tokens.usage: Bottom border of the app bar.

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: Dot grid on the preview canvas behind the sheet.

families.display: "Schibsted Grotesk", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Noto Nastaliq Urdu", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "Instrument Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Noto Nastaliq Urdu", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Instrument Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
families.urdu: "Noto Nastaliq Urdu", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and the pricing headline. Once per page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Landing section heads, the empty dashboard welcome.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page title, once per page, under the breadcrumb or back link.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles inside a page; dialog titles.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card, panel and drawer section titles.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat tiles and score rings. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Reading copy: onboarding, letters, expert bios, help pages.
styles.sample: Paste a job ad and see which skills your CV already shows.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, card copy, inputs.
styles.sample: Saved 2 minutes ago on this device.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body: names in lists, card titles in dense grids.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, menu items, tab labels.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Text inside buttons and links that act like buttons.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, meta lines, timestamps, helper text under fields.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrows and table column heads. Uppercase in Latin scripts only.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: IDs, amounts, dates in tables, keyword tokens. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body-ar
styles.usage: Arabic UI and CV text: one step larger than body, taller lines.

styles.name: body-ur
styles.usage: Urdu in Nastaliq: tall ascenders and descenders need twice the line height.

spacing.note: A 4px scale. Lay out siblings with gap, not margins.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-0_5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, badge inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps: icon and label inside chips, stacked meta lines.

tokens.name: space-1_5
tokens.usage: Label to input; icon to text inside buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls in a toolbar; list item inner padding (block).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button inline padding (md); between items in a card list; table cell inline padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between form fields; card padding on phones; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; dialog body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid; page gutter from 768px; section gap inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page top padding under the app bar.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major regions on wide pages and marketing bands.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm (pricing, landing).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero padding on marketing pages.

radius.note: Corners grow with the size of the object: controls 8, cards 12, dialogs 16.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard keys, tiny tags inside dense tables, checkbox corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, tooltips, segmented-control thumb.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menu items, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus, popovers, kanban cards, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, the sheet frame on the canvas, large feature cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, switches, score rings, status dots.

shadow.note: Flat by default. Shadows mark things that float; borders separate everything else.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Resting cards and inputs that sit on canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the segmented-control thumb, hovered interactive cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Things that float over content: menus, popovers, toasts, the dragged kanban card.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and drawers.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: The CV sheet on the preview canvas and thumbnails of it.

size.note: Control heights, icon sizes and layout widths.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, inputs in dense toolbars and table rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height for buttons, inputs, selects, tabs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary call to action on marketing and auth pages; mobile footer buttons.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on phones; pad small controls up to this.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in badges, chips, captions and small buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in buttons, navigation and inputs.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Empty states, feature tiles, step tiles.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatars in comments and dense lists.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Avatars in the app bar and tables.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Expert profiles and account pages.

tokens.name: app-bar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the global app bar.

tokens.name: side-nav-width
tokens.usage: Width of section navigation (account, organisation, admin).

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Collapsed step rail and icon-only navigation.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: Side drawers (application details, comments, filters).

tokens.name: dialog-sm
tokens.usage: Confirmations and short forms.

tokens.name: dialog-md
tokens.usage: Default dialogs.

tokens.name: dialog-lg
tokens.usage: Previews, booking, tailoring review.

tokens.name: container-sm
tokens.usage: Reading width: auth, onboarding, settings forms.

tokens.name: container-md
tokens.usage: Single-column tools: letters, interview practice.

tokens.name: container-lg
tokens.usage: Default page width: dashboard, jobs, orgs, experts.

tokens.name: container-xl
tokens.usage: Wide tools: tracker board, editor workspace, admin tables.

breakpoint.note: Mobile first: styles apply from this width up.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones: two-column field rows start.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: page gutter grows to space-6; drawers become side sheets.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptops: side navigation shows; editor offers Split view.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktops: three-column grids; tracker shows five columns without scrolling.

tokens.name: bp-2xl
tokens.usage: Wide screens: container-xl tools stop growing.

zIndex.note: Stacking order. Never invent a z-index between these.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Page content.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table heads, sticky editor footers.

tokens.name: z-app-bar
tokens.usage: The global app bar.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawers and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers (they can open inside dialogs).

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.
